Glossary
Set Tiebreak Win/Loss record for 1st or 2nd sets resulting in a 7-6 outcome.
3rd Set Tiebreak Win/Loss record for 3rd set tiebreakers.
Postseason Record Win/Loss record for league matches played beyond local play.
Games Per Set Modified number of games won in a standard 6 game set that applies to 1st and 2nd sets. 3rd sets are modified to 1 game.
Double Bagel Number of matches resulting in a 6-0 6-0 outcome.
Bagel and Breadstick Number of matches resulting in either a 6-0 6-1 or 6-1 6-0 outcome.
Double Breadstick Number of matches resulting in a 6-1 6-1 outcome.
